heading-section.purpose: Brand mark and eyebrows — the one place tracking goes wide (UPPERCASE, +0.06em).

body.purpose: Default reading text, 15px, slight negative tracking. Cap measure 65–75ch.

body-strong.purpose: Component names, card titles, the price figure.

shadows.name: accent-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary (ink) button hover/active — a tighter darker press.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The system's single easing — settles into place, never elastic.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Entrances, card lifts, the live build settle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ink-filled primary action. One per context.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: #111113; border: 1px solid #111113; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 16px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,15,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,10,15,0.05); transition: background 140ms, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2c2c30; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(10,10,15,0.22); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,15,0.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,17,19,0.16); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action — hairline border on white.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; color: #56565c; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #e6e6e9; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0a0a0b; border-color: #cdcdd2; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,17,19,0.16); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Filter/metadata chip. Selection shown by ink, never a colored fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #56565c; background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #e6e6e9; border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 140ms, border-color 140ms, background 140ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #cdcdd2; color: #0a0a0b; } .ds-chip--selected { color: #fff; background: #111113; border-color: #111113; }

components.name: Component Card
components.description: Content card — image, name, price. Border-first, lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e6e9; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,10,15,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,10,15,0.05); transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 140ms, box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: #cdcdd2; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(10,10,15,0.08), 0 2px 4px rgba(10,10,15,0.05); } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #0a0a0b; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card__price { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: #56565c; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Text field — hairline border, ink focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; color: #0a0a0b; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e6e9; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; transition: border-color 140ms, box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #97979e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #111113; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(17,17,19,0.16); }

components.name: Compatibility Badge
components.description: Build-state badge. Color always paired with text (never color alone).
components.html: Compatible
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; } .ds-badge--ok { color: #178a2e; background: rgba(26,174,57,0.08); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-nav link with the ink underline that grows on hover and fills when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #97979e; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 0; transition: color 140ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 6px; height: 2px; background: #111113; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: center; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #56565c; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(0.5); } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #111113; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link--active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: BikeBuilder looks the way a well-made bike part feels in the hand: precise, monochrome, and quietly confident. The system is built almost entirely from neutral grays and a single near-black ink on crisp white panels floating on a light neutral-gray canvas. There is no decorative color, no brand purple, no gradient flourish — restraint is the statement. Color enters only where it carries meaning: green for compatible, amber for caution, red for error.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome by doctrine: one near-black ink, a neutral gray ramp, color reserved for meaning.
Crisp white surfaces over a light-gray canvas, separated by hairline borders and soft neutral shadows.
Inter everywhere, tuned with negative tracking on body and wide tracking on labels.
Tight radii (6–12px) and restrained padding — engineered, not soft.
Restrained entrance motion that settles into place; subtle, one-shot, never elastic or perpetual.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one accent — Machined Ink. No second brand color is ever introduced for decoration. Visual interest comes from hierarchy, spacing, and the component image.

rules.name: The Color-Means-Something Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red are reserved for build state. Never used decoratively, and never signal state with color alone — pair with text or an icon.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries everything. Never pair it with a second sans. Contrast is made with weight and size, not a new font.

rules.name: The Tracking-Tells-Role Rule
rules.body: Negative tracking = reading text. Positive tracking = labels, brand, eyebrows.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from the 1px hairline and the tonal step first; shadow is the second layer, used to lift on interaction.

dos: Do keep the palette monochrome. Build interest from hierarchy, spacing, weight, and component imagery — not from a new hue.
Do reserve green/amber/red strictly for build state, and always pair them with text or an icon.
Do structure surfaces with the 1px hairline and the white-on-gray tonal step first; add shadow only to lift on interaction.
Do make the running price and compatibility the most legible elements on any build screen.
Do drive hierarchy with Inter's weights and tracking; negative tracking for reading, positive for labels and brand.
Do use the mechanical motion vocabulary — fadeInUp / fadeIn on cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 140–220ms — so feedback settles into place.
donts: Don't ship the generic SaaS dashboard: no cream-and-purple template palette, no hero-metric cards, no endless identical icon-card grids.
Don't ship the cluttered parts catalog: no Amazon/eBay listing-spam density.
Don't ship the childish gamified toy: no cartoon energy, no confetti, no badges, no bouncy/elastic motion.
Don't introduce a second brand color or a gradient for decoration. One ink, period.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism, or a >1px colored side-stripe border on cards or rows.
Don't use perpetual or looping motion — no infinite float/pulse/bob. Motion is one-shot: it plays on load or interaction, then stops.
Don't re-introduce a global motion kill-switch in index.css. The prefers-reduced-motion block is the correct, accessible way to suppress motion.
